prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.251, what is the legal stopping distance at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Stop within 2 to 5 feet from the nearest rail when a train is approaching
Stop within 75 to 100 feet from the nearest rail when a train is approaching
Stop within 15 to 50 feet from the nearest rail when a train is approaching
Drivers are never required to stop unless crossing arms make contact with car
